title: 683. Strange Printer

examples.explanation: Print all a at once, then overwrite the tail with b.
Print aaa first, then paint the middle b.
All letters differ, so each needs its own turn.

hints: Squeeze out consecutive repeats first; they never cost extra.
For interval [l, r], start with solving [l, r-1] plus one turn for s[r].
When s[k] equals s[r], the turn painting s[r] can share the turn painting s[k]: try dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r-1].
